title: Bigelow to receive UFO material from Lockheed Martin, transfer blocked by Glenn Gaffney

tellings.quote: suites billionaire who uh was supposed to actually get UFO material from Loheed Martin in 2008

plain: In 2008 a billionaire named Robert Bigelow was supposed to receive UFO material from Lockheed Martin, a large American defence company, but the transfer was blocked by a man named Glenn Gaffney. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, while speaking with the researcher Jeffrey Mishlove. If true, it would mean a private defence company held UFO material and someone stepped in to keep it from leaving.
